proposals.evidence: DEDR4395(a) gives Tamil peṇ/peṇṭu woman/wife, Malayalam peṇ/peṇṭi girl, Kannada peṇṇu, peṇḍir, peṇḍati and heṅgasu female, and Tulu poṇṇu girl. These simple peṇ/peṇḍ-/heṇ/engas-type responses are comparative members of that female family with ordinary endings and source vowels/aspiration retained. Larger person/child compounds are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
